The name Zihayr reflects this spiritual significance by recognizing the importance of giving and charitable acts in the Islamic faith. It serves as a reminder of the spiritual rewards that come from giving, and the impact it can have on both the giver and the recipient. Additionally, the name Zihayr can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic belief in the unity and interconnectedness of all things.
